workflow.noChannel: No enabled, approved channel is available for this mailbox and purpose.
workflow.trackingDescription: This records open and link requests. Mail providers and security scanners may create them automatically, so they do not show that a person read or clicked the message and are not delivery or read receipts.
workflow.trackingActive: Tracking is enabled for this message.
workflow.trackingOff: Tracking is off for this message.
workflow.engagementRequestDisclaimer: Mail proxies or security scanners may create these requests. They do not confirm that a person read the message or that it was delivered. Counts stop changing 30 days after the message is frozen.
workflow.meetingTypesLoadFailed: Meeting types could not be loaded.
workflow.noActiveMeetingTypes: No active meeting types are available.
workflow.freezeBlocked: Only a draft message can be frozen.
workflow.frozen: The message is frozen. Review this exact snapshot before submitting.
workflow.subject: Subject
workflow.preflightDescription: This check is non-binding. Sending is still checked again immediately before the provider call.
workflow.preflightRequired: Run the policy check before submitting this message.
workflow.preflightNotAuthorization: A policy check is not authorization to send.
workflow.preflightPassed: Current policy checks passed. Review the frozen snapshot and confirm the separate human send action.
workflow.preflightBlocked: Sending is blocked until every policy check passes.
workflow.humanSendRequired: Direct submission is available to authorized human users only.
workflow.sendGrantRequired: This mailbox has not granted you permission to send messages.
workflow.approvalRequired: This message needs a separate approval before it can be sent.
workflow.approvalPending: This message is waiting for a different approver.
workflow.approvalValidDescription: Approval is valid for this frozen snapshot. A human must still confirm send.
workflow.approvalInvalidDescription: Approval is no longer valid or has expired. Refresh status before sending.
workflow.approvalSnapshotMismatch: Approval does not match the current frozen snapshot. Request a new approval before sending.
workflow.approvalStatusOther: Approval status: {status}. Sending is blocked until a valid approval exists.
workflow.approvalReason: Why is this message being requested for approval?
workflow.approvalCreated: Approval request created. A different approver must review it.
workflow.approvalApproved: A separate approver approved this snapshot. Refresh policy and confirm a separate human send action.
workflow.confirmSubmitDescription: This separate human action queues the frozen message for dispatch. Review the frozen sender, recipient, subject, and body. Provider acceptance and delivery are reported separately.
workflow.queued: Message queued for dispatch. Provider acceptance and delivery are still unconfirmed.
workflow.accepted: The provider accepted this message. This does not confirm delivery or reading.
workflow.unknown: The send outcome is unknown. Do not resend. Use status lookup and operator reconciliation guidance.
workflow.confirmCancelDescription: Cancellation is available only before the provider call starts.
workflow.versionConflict: This draft or send changed. Refresh its status before continuing.
workflow.acceptedNotDelivered: Accepted is not the same as delivered or read.
workflow.readOnly: This send has crossed the submission boundary. Only status lookup is available here.

history.subject: Message
history.emptyDescription: Messages you create will appear here until you submit them.
